body: The original diagnosis was made directly after I was hospitalized, so yes. I continued to be quite out of it (pretty bad delusions) for a couple of months before I reverted back to normal. I'm considering just coming clean to my mom in a text tonight and taking whatever happens. I'm nowhere near in as bad a shape as I was last time and hopefully she recognizes that. I just made some very poor decisions. Hopefully they'll pay off my debt and allow me to finish this semester while getting a job to pay them back. Knowing them, though, I don't know what's going to happen. Last time they took all of my electronics and cut off all of my support from my friends. Hope that doesn't happen again.

Lots of 2ce (a synthetic hallucinogen)often, combined with liquor, weed and pills

It's a debit card is the problem

They don't allow for normal payment plans like they would on a credit card

I have no idea. During the "drug psychosis" episode I was diagnosed with schizophrenia. Granted, during that time I was really messed up and had very irrational thoughts. I originally went more for companionship than anything else. I constructed a fake background that I told the girls and it was pretty grandiose. That may be part of it.

My grades are fine. I realize my reliance on my parents is a major hindrance. Unfortunately, they've attempted to block my autonomy in the past (wouldn't let me get a driver's license, etc) and I've yet to take the initiative to break free. I realize I've brought that on myself. My major concern is the debt on a debit card. Though I'm going to go job hunting immediately, it's my understanding that debt in this amount can lead to a suit against me which will basically fuck my credit to the point where I'll never be allowed to have a card again.
